author: Matt Wolfe
description:
CES is always full of impressive tech. But it’s also where some truly bizarre products see the light of day.

In this video, I’m diving into the weirdest, most confusing, and most questionable tech I came across at CES 2026. These aren’t concepts or vaporware. These are real products that real companies brought to the biggest tech show in the world.

Some are kind of brilliant. Some are completely unnecessary. And some made me stop and ask who exactly this was made for. Either way, CES would not be CES without them.

So... remember, just because you can make something, doesn't mean you should!
